verdict.rationale: A SaaS dashboard product like WorkOS could plausibly ship a built-in AI assistant, so the axis applies. The evidence shows only an official remote MCP server that lets external MCP-compatible agents act on the workspace. That is an adjacent integration point, not an assistant built into the product, and no evidence shows an in-product assistant you can delegate tasks to.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product
